import ctypes, os
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
fd = libc.syscall(2, b'tests/raw.txt', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
assert fd >= 0, ctypes.get_errno()
os.write(fd, b'raw'); os.close(fd)
